title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Ezra 6: Darius finds Cyrus' decree, the temple is finished and dedicated, and the Passover is kept with joy.

questions.text: Where was the scroll with Cyrus' decree found?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:2 says a scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace in the province of Media.

questions.text: According to Cyrus' decree, what was to be the height of God's house?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:3 says its height was to be sixty cubits, and its width sixty cubits.

questions.text: Out of what were the building expenses to be paid?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:4 says the expenses were to be given out of the king's house.

answers.text: Out of gifts from the elders of the Jews

questions.text: Who had taken the gold and silver vessels of God's house to Babylon?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:5 says Nebuchadnezzar took them out of the temple in Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.

questions.text: What punishment did Darius decree for anyone who altered his message?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:11-12 says a beam was to be pulled out of his house, he was to be fastened on it, and his house made a dunghill; "I Darius have made a decree."

answers.text: He would be thrown into a den of lions
A beam pulled from his house and he fastened on it
He would be sent into exile in Babylon
He would pay a fine of one hundred talents

questions.text: Through whose prophesying did the elders of the Jews build and prosper?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:14 says they built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo.

questions.text: In which month was the house finished?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:15 says the house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius.

questions.text: What did they offer as a sin offering for all Israel at the dedication?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:17 says they offered twelve male goats as a sin offering, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

questions.text: On which day did the children of the captivity keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:19 says they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

answers.text: The fourteenth day of the first month
The first day of the seventh month
The tenth day of the first month
The fifteenth day of the second month

questions.text: Whose heart had Yahweh turned to the people, to strengthen their hands in the work?
questions.explanation: Ezra 6:22 says Yahweh had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them.
